import subprocess, ctypes, torch, math, shutil, os
src = open('/tmp/tcmc.cu').read() if os.path.exists('/tmp/tcmc.cu') else None
print("cached src:", src is not None)
if src is None: raise SystemExit
# mode bit0: W tile index blockIdx%8 (12 MB working set, L2-hot); bit1: skip MMAs (feed only)
src = src.replace("int kbs, int stages, int tmem_cols, unsigned long long* dbg) {\n  uint64_t t0c",
                  "int kbs, int stages, int tmem_cols, unsigned long long* dbg, int mode) {\n  uint64_t t0c")
src = src.replace('"l"(pol) : "memory");\n      for (int j', '"l"(pol) : "memory");\n      (void)0;\n      for (int j')
src = src.replace('::"r"(a), "l"((uint64_t)&mapW), "r"(fb), "r"(0), "r"(m0), "r"(i * kbs), "l"(pol)',
                  '::"r"(a), "l"((uint64_t)&mapW), "r"(fb), "r"(0), "r"((mode & 1) ? (int)(blockIdx.x & 7) * kRows : m0), "r"(i * kbs), "l"(pol)')
src = src.replace("const uint32_t acc = (i | j | k) != 0;", "const uint32_t acc = (i | j | k) != 0;\n          if (mode & 2) continue;")
src = src.replace("tmem_cols, dbg);", "tmem_cols, dbg, mode);")
src = src.replace("int kbs_ov, int st_ov, unsigned long long* dbg, cudaStream_t stream)", "int kbs_ov, int st_ov, unsigned long long* dbg, cudaStream_t stream, int mode)")
open('/tmp/tcm2.cu','w').write(src)
nvcc = shutil.which('nvcc') or '/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc'
r = subprocess.run([nvcc,'-O3','-std=c++17','-shared','-Xcompiler','-fPIC','-gencode','arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a','-o','/tmp/tcm2.so','/tmp/tcm2.cu','-lcuda'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print("nvcc", r.returncode, r.stderr[-2000:])
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/tcm2.so')
lib.tc_launch.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]*4 + [ctypes.c_int]*4 + [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
W = torch.randn(18432,3072,device='cuda')/math.sqrt(3072); bias = torch.randn(18432,device='cuda')
flushbuf = torch.empty(256*1024*1024//4, device='cuda')
dbg = torch.zeros(144*4, dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
def run(B, mc, mode, kbs=0, st=0, flush=True):
    emb = torch.randn(B,3072,device='cuda'); outs=[torch.zeros(B,3072,device='cuda') for _ in range(6)]
    arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
    best=None
    for rep in range(4):
        if flush: flushbuf.zero_()
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        rc=lib.tc_launch(emb.data_ptr(), W.data_ptr(), bias.data_ptr(), arr, B, mc, kbs, st, dbg.data_ptr(), torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream, mode)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        d=dbg.view(144,4).cpu(); dc=(d[:,1]-d[:,0]).double(); dg=(d[:,3]-d[:,2]).double()
        v=(dc.max().item(), (dc/dg).median().item(), rc)
        if rep>0 and (best is None or v[0]<best[0]): best=v
    return best
for rnd in range(2):
  for B in (16,132,192,211,256):
    line=[]
    for mc in (0,1):
      if mc and B<=131 and B!=132: continue
      for mode,name in ((0,'cold'),(1,'hotW'),(2,'cold-noMMA'),(3,'hotW-noMMA')):
        c,clk,rc=run(B,mc,mode, flush=(mode&1)==0)
        line.append(f"{'mc' if mc else 'base'}/{name}={c/1000:.1f}k@{clk:.2f}{'' if rc==0 else ' rc'+str(rc)}")
    Bpad=(B+15)//16*16
    print(f"r{rnd} B={B} ideal={2*128*Bpad*3072/4096/1000:.1f}k  "+"  ".join(line))
